title: spec: IOwnershipQueueService reads take the caller package, so a queue recipient resolves by D3 from its rule (ADR-0150, follow-up of E4)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQXLfvyB5R53VDm3Ka

Filing gate: ④ coordination node: a follow-up of child E4 #31675 of the epic #31527 (ADR-0150), owed by E4's PR #31728 and accepted as an interim by the epic seat (PR review 6729421618). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: inherited from the parent #31527. A sharing rule shipped by package P that names a queue should reach P's queue, or the unique one in P's declared dependency closure, and be refused with the candidates otherwise (ADR-0150 D3). Today the queue contract carries no caller package, so after plugin-sharing's P-side check the queue still resolves environment-wide: a queue name that P's closure reaches once but an unrelated package also holds is refused. That is stricter than D3 (never looser), so nothing is served wrongly, but a valid rule can be refused once two packages share a queue name.
Reader: the `domain:spec` seat, then the `domain:server` seat that wires plugin-sharing's `ownership-queue-service.ts` to the new argument.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `IOwnershipQueueService caller package` (6; top hits #31675(open) #30251(closed) #28508(closed), none on point: #31675 is E4 itself; #30251 added `onFailedRead`; #28508 is older queue work).
class: d · type: Feature
Part of #31527.

## 维护者速读

共享规则引用队列时，队列契约还不知道是哪个软件包在问，所以现在比规则要求的更严：两个包同名的队列会被拒绝。这张卡给队列契约加上调用方软件包参数，让它按统一规则解析。

## What to build

- `packages/spec`: the `IOwnershipQueueService` read methods (`expandMembers`, `isMember`, and any other read that takes a queue name) gain an optional caller-package argument. Its absence keeps today's environment-wide read.
- plugin-sharing: a declared rule's queue recipient passes its rule's package, and the queue resolves through objectql's `resolvePackageScopedName` from that package (own package, then declared closure plus `sys`, else a refusal naming every candidate).
- Clause-②: yes (widening) for the spec contract (an added optional argument); the plugin-sharing half narrows nothing beyond #31728's declared refusals.

## Acceptance

- The epic's three red lines (#31527): no first-registered fallback, every refusal names every candidate, independently releasable.
- A pin: a rule in P naming queue `q`, where `q` is held by P's dependency D and also by an unrelated package U, resolves to D's queue (red on today's `main`).
